IET 101.name: Manufacturing Materials, Processes, and Laboratory
IET 101.description: Mechanical properties of materials; primary processing methods used in manufacturing; ferrous and nonferrous metals; important plastic plus ceramic materials; dimensional verification and measurements; mechanical properties evaluation; laboratory methods; statistical interpretation of data.

IET 215.name: Production Design
IET 215.description: The study of manufacturing processes for the purpose of part creation and/or part feature creation using both current and advanced technologies.

IET 216.name: Production Design Laboratory
IET 216.description: Laboratory methods in production design including conventional and advanced manufacturing processes, computer applications, and automation/robotics.

IET 297.name: Special Topics
IET 297.description: Formal courses given infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject which may be topical or of special interest.

IET 308.name: Statistical Quality Control
IET 308.description: Fundamentals of probability and statistics, introduction to quality control fundamentals, control charts, acceptance sampling.

IET 311.name: Elements of Metallurgy
IET 311.description: Introduction to metallurgical concepts, metallurgical testing, phase diagram studies, heat treating concepts, ferrous and nonferrous systems.

IET 321.name: Manufacturing Processes
IET 321.description: Manufacturing processes for producing metal, plastic, and ceramic items. Primary emphasis is placed on machine tool processes.

IET 333.name: Engineering Economics for Technologists
IET 333.description: Fundamentals of engineering economics; equivalence and rate of return analysis; replacement models; depreciation and tax considerations; and economic decision making for technologists.
